reader.requirement: At --std 85 each level-number 01 entry (written 01 or 1) under an RD begins a new report group whose subordinate entries belong to it alone, and an entry before any 01 entry belongs to no report group and is refused.

reader.notes: BindReportEntry opens a ReportGroupModel at every level-1 entry and attaches later entries to it until the next one; an entry with no open group is refused with COBOL2772. The probe shows the groups are kept apart at run time.

refuter.evidence: h1_01_elementary (01 D1 TYPE DE LINE PLUS 1 COLUMN 1 PIC X(2) VALUE ...): refused COBOL2247 citing §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR3, SR4a (a 01 entry is format 1, no PICTURE/COLUMN/VALUE); h4_01_no_type: second 01 with no TYPE refused COBOL2247; h2 level 77, h3 level 50, h6 level 88 in the RD refused COBOL1746 (1985 SR2: 01 through 49 only); h5_two_groups_sources: two 01 groups keep their own items (DA 123, DB XYZ, DA 456). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.14.4 GR1  (3.14.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.14.3 SR2  (3.14.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2'.
